_doc: The binary star every planet of the system sees (systems/solar_system.gd SolarSystem.suns_for(planet_id)). star_a is the warm primary (carries shadows), star_b the smaller cooler companion (unshadowed warm fill). size = angular size multiplier (1 = the primary seen from 1 au), energy = light multiplier; both scale with orbital distance as size / orbit_au and energy / orbit_au^2 (clamped by min_energy / max_energy). Each planet's own orbit (orbit_au, tilt_deg, sep_deg, sep_angle_deg, day_length_s, moons, day_stars) is the `orbit` block of its look table (planets/<id>/data/look.json).
